brief: A three-storey spice tower for the kitchen counter, one cell wide, with a bin on each storey.

requirements.evidence: 3 full bases stacked at 0,0 levels 0-2, verified clear
binBolt side bins on levels 0,1,2; drop-in bins refused COLLAR_IN_WAY on stacked column, so top-entry bins unmet
soil-filled side bins planted with mint, basil, parsley; visible in look

finish.summary: 3-high single-cell tower with a soil-filled bolt-on side bin per storey planted with herbs. Drop-in top bins cannot coexist with stacking collars, so side bins used instead.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
